Name: Always Raining in the Valley Kids - Children grow up
Author: HimeTarts
Description:

[size=3][b][i]I used to hate the rain once, and then I married you... Now I long for storms.[/i]

[/b][/size]🍂If you enjoy my work, please consider supporting me on [url=https://www.patreon.com/Himetarts]Patreon[/url]. 
No mod content will ever be paywalled, but your support helps me to continue development.🍂﻿

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QpjZO2D.png[/img][/center] ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿[b] ﻿[size=3]Come spend awhile with the growing Cooper Family!
[/size][/b][center]You can certify your house will be a riot with these two in it.[/center]
[size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/mcEsf8m.png[/img]﻿﻿﻿ ﻿ ﻿[b]Meet your Daughter,[/b] a precocious young girl with a fierce spirit of adventure! Nurture your budding engineer in all
﻿ ﻿ ﻿   her scientific and mechanical pursuits! ... When she is not terrorizing her brother and daddy, that is. [/size]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mcEsf8m.png[/img]﻿﻿﻿ ﻿ ﻿[size=3][b]Meet your Son, [/b]a quiet young man with a gentle disposition, and boundless compassion to offer the world. Even its
﻿﻿    most small denizens. Nurture his poetic streak, and perhaps one day he'll feel comfortable enough to begin sharing
﻿ ﻿ ﻿   the deepest contents of his heart with his family too. [/size]


[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/bPXjDwq.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/bPXjDwq.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/bPXjDwq.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/bPXjDwq.png[/img]﻿﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/bPXjDwq.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/bPXjDwq.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/bPXjDwq.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/bPXjDwq.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/bPXjDwq.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/bPXjDwq.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/bPXjDwq.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/bPXjDwq.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/bPXjDwq.png[/img][/center]

﻿ ﻿ ﻿[size=3]ARV Kids is a Little NPCs content pack that turns your toddlers into [b]real, dynamic NPCs[/b] for you to experience! 

﻿ ﻿ ﻿Settle into married life alongside your children, and get to know their curious minds as they grow older alongside you.
﻿ ﻿ ﻿This content pack includes years worth of [b]randomized dialogue[/b] for your children, over [b]150+ new marriage dialogue[/b] 
﻿ ﻿ ﻿lines for Sterling, and plenty of fun things for you to discover with your little family, in hopes for adding some much 
﻿ ﻿ ﻿needed longevity to your playthroughs, post happily ever after with Sterling.



[img]https://i.imgur.com/rIryvWp.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OgBhcuw.png[/img]  ﻿[b]Major Expansions, [/b]ARV kids is compatible with all major expansions such as SVE, ES, RSV, DTZ, etc.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OgBhcuw.png[/img] ﻿[b]The Farmer's Children, [/b]is incompatible with ARV Kids, due to both mods having the same purpose of aging up your
﻿ ﻿children. Please remove ARV Kids if you wish to use Farmer's Children or vice versa. You may only have one of these
﻿ ﻿mods installed﻿ per playthrough.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/OgBhcuw.png[/img] ﻿[b]Unique Children Talk & Immersive Family, [/b]for a detailed guide on how to play with both mods installed, read [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23234]here.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/wJ2DZam.png[/img]
